messages:
Jamie: quick sprint-snap — one-paragraph updates. please reply only if youre blocking or need a hand.

Alex: Done yesterday — updated the routing spec (v2) to include fallback policy and rollout knobs. PR #492 opened, description has traffic curve and rollback plan.

Maya: Blocker: integration tests failing in dedupe stage. Error shows `Batcher error: seq_len mismatch` when payloads with mixed lengths hit the continuous-batcher. Investigating — might be batcher config.

Sam: Today I'll review Alex's PR and help Maya repro the dedupe failure locally. If it's a config diff, will propose a small runtime guard.

Liz: We need a QA owner for the canary window or we push. @Pat — can you take it?

Pat: I can own QA for the canary window on 2026-04-07 10:00-12:00 PT. Will run smoke + perf + output-regression. Need test dataset pointer and the quick checklist.

Alex: dataset: `s3://redwood-tests/canary/2026-03-samples`. Adding link to PR and release notes now. Checklist: smoke, perf spike, 3 prompt-regressions, latency SLO.

deploy-bot: Canary window request received. Tentative slot 2026-04-07 10:00 PT. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/canary-checklist

Maya: Quick config test: bumped `max_batch_tokens: 8192` -> `12288` in local dev — integration tests started passing. Pushing branch for CI.

Sam: If that fixes it we should add a guard in the runtime to log seq_len mismatches before crashing. I'll draft a tiny hotfix and tag it for review.

Jamie: Prioritization call: hotfix for stability > non-critical perf opt. thumbs?

Liz: :thumbsup: agree.

Alex: pinging @Taylor (eng-runtime) for code review on PR #492 and the hotfix once ready.

Taylor: (eng-runtime) Ill review PR #492 in ~2h. If Maya's branch is ready, send me the compare link.

Maya: CI passing now, pushing branch `fix/batcher-seqlen`. Link in PR description.

Sam: Good. After merge, @deploy-bot please stage the canary. Also product needs the short release blurb — Alex?

Alex: Added a 2-sentence blurb to the release notes and PR.

Pat: QA checklist (short): 1) smoke, 2) perf spike (10k qps sim, 30m), 3) 3 reg prompts, 4) end-to-end latency SLO check. I'll upload artifacts to `s3://redwood-tests/canary/results/2499012345`.

deploy-bot: Canary staged. Monitoring window active until 2026-04-07 12:00 PT. Alerts routed to #eng-oncall.

Alex: merging PR now.

Taylor: Noting a minor GPU mem spike on one node during perf test (2% of samples). Ill open a follow-up infra ticket.

Maya: Noted — will follow up with eng-infra on batching behavior and kernel selection.

Jamie: Summary: PR merge + canary stage + QA run by Pat. Hotfix preferred over nonessential changes. If monitoring stays green, proceed to broader rollout. Thanks all.

Liz: No more blockers from product. Keep this thread updated with any regressions.

Pat: QA done after smoke/perf/reg checks — all within SLO. Upload complete. Link: `s3://redwood-tests/canary/results/2499012345/report.html`.

deploy-bot: Canary complete — no automatic rollback triggered.

Alex: shipping notes updated, will schedule rollout tomorrow morning.

Jamie: closing this micro-snap as green. If anything pops, re-open thread. Thanks :rocket:
